n_640fa53e283e143d.name: Read tagged workflows
n_640fa53e283e143d.source: export default async function pages({previous},context){const s=previous??{items:[],cursor:null,seen:[]};const r=await context.actions.call('n8n.list_workflows',{limit:100,tags:['sync-to-notion'],...(s.cursor?{cursor:s.cursor}:{})});if(!Array.isArray(r?.data))throw Error('Invalid n8n workflow page');const cursor=r.nextCursor;if(cursor!==null&&(typeof cursor!=='string'||!cursor||s.seen.includes(cursor)))throw Error('Invalid or repeated workflow cursor');return{state:{items:[...s.items,...r.data],cursor,seen:cursor?[...s.seen,cursor]:s.seen},more:cursor!==null};}

n_3b4fbb5c2ad80529.name: Prepare the next workflow
n_3b4fbb5c2ad80529.source: export default function next({state,previous,instanceUrl,dataSourceId}){if(!Array.isArray(state?.items)||typeof instanceUrl!=='string'||!/^https:\/\/[^/?#\s]+\/$/i.test(instanceUrl)||instanceUrl.includes('YOUR_')||typeof dataSourceId!=='string'||!dataSourceId||dataSourceId.includes('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure an HTTPS instance URL and Notion data source ID');const i=previous?.index??0;if(!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0)throw Error('Invalid workflow index');if(i>=state.items.length)return{state:{index:i},more:false,item:{},dataSourceId};const w=state.items[i];if(!w||typeof w.id!=='string'||!w.id||typeof w.name!=='string'||!w.name||typeof w.active!=='boolean'||typeof w.createdAt!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(w.createdAt))||typeof w.updatedAt!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(w.updatedAt))||!w.settings||typeof w.settings!=='object'||Array.isArray(w.settings))throw Error('Invalid workflow data');return{state:{index:i+1},more:true,item:{id:w.id,name:w.name,active:w.active,createdAt:w.createdAt,updatedAt:w.updatedAt,errorWorkflow:!!w.settings.errorWorkflow,url:instanceUrl+'workflow/'+encodeURIComponent(w.id),envId:'internal-'+w.id},dataSourceId};}

n_e7881919a598e53c.name: Prepare the exact ID lookup
n_e7881919a598e53c.source: export default function fields({item}){if(!item||typeof item.envId!=='string'||!item.envId)throw Error('Invalid workflow');return{filter:{property:'env id',rich_text:{equals:item.envId}}};}

n_9629b424bd8b05e0.name: Prepare the inventory entry
n_9629b424bd8b05e0.source: export default function decide({result,item,dataSourceId}){if(!result||!Array.isArray(result.results)||typeof result.has_more!=='boolean'||result.has_more||result.results.length>1)throw Error('Ambiguous Notion workflow match');const existing=result.results[0];if(existing&&(existing.object!=='page'||typeof existing.id!=='string'||!existing.id))throw Error('Invalid Notion match');const text=x=>[{text:{content:String(x)}}],props={Name:{title:text(item.name)},'env id':{rich_text:text(item.envId)},'URL (dev)':{url:item.url},'isActive (dev)':{checkbox:item.active},'Workflow created at':{date:{start:item.createdAt}},'Workflow updated at':{date:{start:item.updatedAt}},'Error workflow setup':{checkbox:item.errorWorkflow}};return{create:!existing,pageId:existing?.id??'unused',parent:{data_source_id:dataSourceId},properties:props};}

n_ae850bdba20ad18a.name: Confirm creation
n_ae850bdba20ad18a.source: export default function confirm({page}){if(!page||page.object!=='page'||typeof page.id!=='string'||!page.id)throw Error('Notion write was not confirmed');return{ok:true};}

n_3b2cdf166ae823b8.name: Confirm update
n_3b2cdf166ae823b8.source: export default function confirm({page}){if(!page||page.object!=='page'||typeof page.id!=='string'||!page.id)throw Error('Notion write was not confirmed');return{ok:true};}
